headline: Turkey Sets 2027 Automotive Export Target at Record $45.5 Billion
summary: Turkey aims to expand its international market presence and reach a record $45.5 billion in automotive sector exports in 2027, according to the government's Presidential Annual Program.
why: The automotive industry is Turkey's leading export manufacturing sector, generating crucial hard currency earnings and industrial employment across European supply chains.

impacts.name: Turkish Automotive
impacts.why: Government export targets signal sustained policy support for vehicle and component manufacturing.
